title: Wells Score — Deep Vein Thrombosis
age_range: adults, non-pregnant; not validated in pregnancy

sources.title: STG & EML Hospital Level Adults, 6th ed. 2024 (updated Mar 2026)
National Integrated Maternal & Perinatal Care Guidelines for SA, 5th ed. 2024
NICE NG158 Venous thromboembolic diseases: diagnosis, management and thrombophilia testing (2020, updated 2023)
Wells PS et al. Lancet 1997;350:1795; N Engl J Med 2003;349:1227
Righini M et al. ADJUST-PE. JAMA 2014;311:1117

components.t: Active cancer (treatment ongoing, within 6 months, or palliative)
Paralysis, paresis or recent plaster immobilisation of the legs
Bedridden ≥3 days or major surgery within 12 weeks
Localised tenderness along the deep venous system
Calf swelling ≥3 cm vs asymptomatic side (10 cm below tibial tuberosity)
Pitting oedema confined to the symptomatic leg
Alternative diagnosis at least as likely as DVT

formulas.name: Age-adjusted D-dimer cut-off (age >50)
formulas.notes: validated in PE (ADJUST-PE); NICE: consider if >50

steps: Proximal leg vein ultrasound, result within 4 h if possible
Scan delayed → D-dimer + interim anticoagulation; scan within 24 h
Scan negative + D-dimer positive → stop anticoag; repeat scan at 6–8 days
D-dimer (result within 4 h); anticoagulate if delayed
D-dimer positive → proximal leg vein ultrasound (as for 'likely')
D-dimer negative → DVT unlikely; stop anticoagulation

interpretation_stg.t: Diagnosis is clinical, confirmed with Duplex Doppler
DDx: cellulitis, superficial thrombophlebitis, Baker's cyst, calf muscle tear, lymphoedema, venous insufficiency, knee derangement
Proximal DVT Rx: rivaroxaban 15 mg 12-hourly × 3 wk, then 20 mg daily × 3 months (check Table 2.5)
Pregnancy: confirm with compression duplex US; strong suspicion → enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC 12-hourly + refer

notes.t: Score the symptomatic leg; if both legs symptomatic, score the worse leg
Do not use D-dimer alone to rule out DVT in 'likely' patients
Original 1997 score has no 'previous DVT' item — modified adds +1

dagger_note: d=true items are not in the SA STG (NICE NG158 / original papers).
card_note: ✚ = SA STG / SA maternity guideline (pages listed above). Unmarked content: NICE NG158 and original papers. Wells is a pre-test probability tool — apply only after clinical suspicion of VTE.
